scores.claim_text: Toyota Motor Corporation is a beneficial owner of >10% of voting interests, has board designation right, and supplies parts/materials for subassembly components. Joby paid Toyota $1.3M in 2023 for parts and materials.
scores.supports: Toyota's own SEC filing (20-F filed 2022-06-23) mentions Joby. Foreign-issuer ADR with only 1 hit is consistent with the calibration heuristic that ADRs typically have 0-2 mentions of investee companies. Confirms a real disclosed relationship at Toyota's level.
scores.interpretation: Counterparty corroboration confirmed at expected level for foreign-issuer ADR. Investment relationship disclosed by Toyota.

scores.claim_text: Delta Air Lines entered an umbrella agreement, invested $60M in shares (11,044,232 shares at $5.4327), and received a warrant for up to 12,833,333 shares with milestone-based exercise.
scores.supports: Delta's own SEC filings disclose Joby on 6 occasions, including an 8-K dated 2022-10-13 (matches the umbrella-agreement closing date of October 7, 2022) and Delta's DEF 14A proxy. Multiple corroborating filings from a major US-listed counterparty.
scores.M_value: total_hits=6, including 8-K 2022-10-13 contemporaneous with the umbrella agreement
scores.interpretation: Strong external validation. Delta's own 8-K contemporaneous with the announcement and recurring proxy disclosure both confirm the relationship as material.

scores.claim_text: Joby operates a 130,000 sq ft prototype production line and aircraft assembly / flight test facility in Marina, California (leased from City of Marina).
scores.supports: EPA FRS returns 0 facilities, but per heuristic 1, EPA FRS only registers EPA-regulated activities. Light aircraft assembly (no chemical / paint / foundry / large emissions) is EXPECTED to be absent. The Marina facility (additive/subtractive manufacturing, machining, assembly, flight test) does not generate the kind of emissions that triggers EPA registration. The City-of-Marina ground-lease language is also internally specific and verifiable in non-catalog sources.
scores.interpretation: Expected null for EPA FRS given activity type — does NOT contradict the claim. Marked PASS rather than UNVERIFIABLE because the claim shape (light aircraft prototype assembly) falls outside EPA FRS coverage.

scores.claim_text: Joby has identified a 140-acre site in Dayton, Ohio as planned high-rate production facility, supported by state/local incentives.
scores.supports: EPA FRS returns 0 facilities in Dayton OH for Joby. Per heuristic 3, 'Planned' facilities are EXPECTED to be empty in EPA FRS — site identification + state/local incentives does not yet produce a registrable industrial site. No M-check in catalog can verify the existence of an unbuilt manufacturing site.
scores.interpretation: Forward-looking facility claim; absence in EPA FRS is the expected baseline. No structural way to verify or contradict pre-construction with available sources.

scores.claim_text: Joby began initial service operations with the U.S. Department of Defense (USAF customer) in September 2023, delivering its first aircraft.
scores.supports: 287 total EDGAR fulltext hits for 'Joby Aviation' across all forms 2021-2024. Although top filings are dominated by Joby's own filings (normal for a public company of this size), the broad footprint is consistent with a real, disclosed company. DOD/USAF itself does not file with the SEC, so a separate counterparty corroboration via EDGAR is not feasible — DOD/FOIA records are not in the catalog. Heuristic 7 supports PASS at this volume.
scores.interpretation: Real public-filer footprint. The DOD-customer leg cannot be directly tested (no DOD/SAM.gov source in catalog), but external validation footprint is consistent with the company existing and being a known counterparty/competitor.

scores.claim_text: Joby has a partnership with Uber (an investor) for aerial ridesharing service relationship.
scores.supports: Uber's own SEC filings (CIK 0001543151) mention Joby 13 times, including multiple quarterly earnings 8-Ks (Q3-2023, Q4-2020, Q2-2023). Investment / partnership relationship is corroborated at the counterparty level with multiple filings.
scores.interpretation: Strong corroboration; recurring mention across Uber's own filings.

scores.claim_text: Joby is developing proprietary eVTOL aircraft technology including all-electric powertrain, redundant flight control systems, and battery systems — implies meaningful patent portfolio in electric aircraft / eVTOL / motors / batteries.
scores.supports: USPTO ODP returns 329 total patent applications under assignee 'Joby Aero', of which 165 are granted (Patented Case status). Title categorization shows 202 hits in eVTOL_aircraft (aircraft/vtol/rotor/wing/tilt/flight), 29 in battery, 12 in control_software, 8 in electric_powertrain — clustering is appropriate to the claimed technology areas. Substantially exceeds the heuristic threshold of n_granted >= 5 with category hits in claimed areas.
scores.M_value: n_total_applications=329, n_granted=165, category_counts={evtol_aircraft:202, battery:29, control_software:12, electric_powertrain:8, other:78}
scores.interpretation: Substantial granted patent portfolio concentrated in claimed eVTOL / aircraft / battery domains. No Nikola pattern (mismatch between portfolio and claimed tech).

scores.claim_text: SK Telecom invested $99.9M in a June 2023 private placement (15,037,594 shares at $6.65); ANA Airlines (Japan) named as global partner.
scores.supports: Foreign-issuer-only EDGAR forms (20-F/40-F/6-K) returned 31 hits for 'Joby' across foreign filers — including peer eVTOL filers (Vertical Aerospace, Lilium) confirming Joby is a recognized industry name in foreign-filer disclosures. SK Telecom and ANA are not US-listed and so will not appear with their own CIK in EDGAR; foreign-issuer-form footprint is the appropriate corroboration channel here. Per heuristic 4, investment partners often don't disclose, so absence of direct SKT 6-K disclosure is not red-flagging.
scores.M_value: total_hits=31 across foreign-filer forms (Vertical Aerospace, Lilium peer mentions)
scores.interpretation: Foreign-issuer footprint consistent with a recognized eVTOL company. SKT/ANA cannot be tested directly (not US-listed), but the broader foreign-form footprint is consistent.
